name: parse / parse_segments

test_list.description: `$websearch find docs` yields WebSearch(On) with span 0..10 and prose `find docs`.
Directives inside `code` spans and ``` fences are prose; the input is unchanged.
`$my-flag(a, k=v, f(x))` is Custom with Atom, Kv and Call args.
`C:\dir` and quoted `C:\Users\me\a b.txt` parse as Atom/Quoted, never as kv or ranges.
`$sandbox(openshell` fails with UnbalancedParen at the `(` offset.
Oversized input is TooLong, `$a(` nesting beyond max_depth is TooDeep, too many args is TooManyArgs.
Every directive catalog row parses to its typed value; `$nebius-sandbox` normalises to Sandbox.
Directives on CRLF-separated lines are found; other lines stay in prose.
parse_segments copies Attachment segments into prose without parsing them.
proptest: arbitrary Unicode never panics; every span is in bounds and on char boundaries.

output_description: Command, directives and mentions with byte spans, plus residual prose.
